d:
Bharat ki janjatiy sanskriti jitni vividh hai, utne hi anuthe hain unke paranprik khela. ye khel keval manoranjan ka sadhan nahin, balki janjatiy jivan, paranpra, chapalta aur kaushal ka abhinn hissa hain.
Is shrrinkhla men dekhie bharat ki janjatiyon ke paranprik khel aur unke jivan ki andekhi jhalka.
